title: detk module JSON document
description: Envelope written by de_toolkit.report.DetkModuleJSON for every tool invocation. The params object records the module's invocation parameters; the properties object carries the module-specific results consumed by the report views.

name.description: module name; lowercased DetkModule subclass name

id.description: content hash of (name, params, input file, detk version); stable across re-runs with identical inputs

detk_version.description: de_toolkit version that wrote this document

last_modified.description: unix timestamp in milliseconds when this document was written

start_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC approximation of process start (module import time)

end_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the module was recorded

argv.description: process argument vector at recording time

in_file_path.description: primary input file path as given on the command line

out_file_path.description: primary output file path, if any

column_data_path.description: column data (sample metadata) file path, if any

params.description: module invocation parameters; empty only for modules that genuinely take none

properties.description: module-specific results used by the report views
